description:
An open-source alternative to Claude Cowork, powered by OpenCode

OpenWork is an extensible, open-source “Claude Work” style system for knowledge workers.
It’s a native desktop app that runs OpenCode under the hood, but presents it as a clean, guided workflow:
- pick a workspace
- start a run
- watch progress + plan updates
- approve permissions when needed
- reuse what works (templates + skills)
The goal: make “agentic work” feel like a product, not a terminal.
Work with OneDrive and SharePoint files in OpenWork
- Work with OneDrive and SharePoint files. Agents can search, open, edit, and save Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files, including files shared with you, once an admin enables the required permission.
- Workbot's Browser and Computer views connect again. If a computer needs an update, Workbot rebuilds it when you open the view; it avoids rebuilding while a task is running.
- Sign-in and connected admin tools are safer. The desktop app now blocks unsafe non-web links from remote MCP sign-in requests. For teams connecting OpenWork to other AI tools, Den admin changes require write access, scripts cannot call admin tools, and credential data cannot be read through den_query.
- For admins and self-hosters: Den gets security and recovery fixes. Self-hosted Den deployments should update for recent Next.js security fixes, and opt-in administrator permission recovery now works with common database encodings. Operators can also enable hashed sign-in session tokens without signing anyone out.
Full changelog: https://openworklabs.com/docs/changelog · Compare
Windows installers are signed using Microsoft Artifact Signing.
